source_locator: Sec.6: efficiency factor (c), failure to deliver negative muons to dt vessels (eta_mu); and, in the same section, we do not know eta_mu and finding it will be the focus of phase three of our research -- for the current phase we will use the arbitrary but reasonable assumption of eta_mu = 50%
derivation: as stated; no normalization. Mapping the source's phrase onto a chain node is OURS: the source names no node, and a muon delivered to a d-t vessel has been captured and transported but not yet moderated or stopped in the fuel, so this edge ends at 'transported'. Ending it there rather than later leaves more of the chain unreached, never less.
notes: bias_direction is 'unknown', not 'lower': the authors state they do not know the value and give no direction, so composing it can understate OR overstate the cost. That is strictly weaker than an OMITTED factor, which is bounded above by 1 and can only understate, and it is why the direction is carried per edge rather than assumed for the whole table.
